title: Figurative Language Practice 1
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused figurative language questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Morning Inbox

By nine o'clock, the inbox was a river of new messages.

TEXT B - Empty Theater

After the audience left, the stage lights watched the empty seats.

TEXT C - Long Form

The permit application was a maze of boxes and signatures.

TEXT D - First Snow

Snow erased the edges of the parking lot by morning.

questions.explanation: River transfers the idea of continuous flow to incoming messages.
questions.rule: Use the exact wording and surrounding context as evidence.

options.whyWrong: “The messages were deleted.” does not fit the way the word, phrase, or technique functions in this specific context.
“The computer was wet.” describes the opposite effect from the one supported by the passage.

options.text: The office was near a river.
options.whyWrong: The passage does not provide evidence for the claim “The office was near a river..” It adds information the text never establishes.

options.text: Messages were arriving in a continuous flow.
